name: @thirdlight/exporter
description: Thirdlight M1 standalone export (docs/contracts/export.md, packet 12): exportProject(ctx) reads the authoring state through the INJECTED workspace service, freezes one runtime snapshot, builds the export bundle (same runtime as play mode — export.md §5), runs the validation pipeline (graph + forbidden-content scan, §4/§5.4), and atomically writes the static output tree. The `.` subpath is the export operation invoked by the backend (sessions.md §6.3) — the browser export bundle entry (src/export-bootstrap.ts) is NOT a public export (it is reached by file path at build time, §4.2).
